summary: VB Risk Advisory B.V. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 67% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: A small risk and compliance advisory firm in Amsterdam and Hoofddorp that holds an IND sponsor licence and mentions visas in most of its postings.

culture.text: All 3 current roles are in risk, compliance and legal: two entry-level and one senior, based in Amsterdam and Hoofddorp.
A posting refers to 4most, a B-Corp credit-risk and actuarial consultancy with over 250 consultants, though the link to VB Risk Advisory is not confirmed.

open.text: VB Risk Advisory B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
2 of its 3 current openings mention visas, and 2 of 3 don't require Dutch.
